metadata.description: Itixo marketplace with plugins for Claude. Recommended: also add the caveman marketplace (https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman) and Mattpocock Skills (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills).

plugins.name: itixo
plugins.description: Itixo library for Claude users: agents, skills, rules, prompts. Orchestration module included (delegation to sonnet/haiku subagents). Recommended companions: the caveman marketplace (https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman) and Mattpocock Skills (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills).

plugins.name: itixo-component-library-tables
plugins.description: This plugin provides the icl-tables skill for building server-side paginated, filterable, sortable, and searchable table endpoints and CSV export using the Itixo.ComponentLibrary.Tables NuGet package.
